_comment: Axis B for IMT_2026 and for verba 1.1 / art. 7.º-A of STAMP_DUTY_2024: end-to-end scenarios captured from TWO independent public simulators. data/imt-2026.source.test.ts already proves the tables were transcribed correctly from the ofício circulado (Axis A); these catch the different failure — applying a correct table the wrong way (wrong table per purpose or territory, the young exemption ceiling, the art. 7.º-A cap, the taxa-única jump).

notarios.name: Ordem dos Notários — Simulador IMT
notarios.why: The notaries execute these deeds for a living, and the simulator returns IMT and the verba 1.1 selo together.
notarios.method: Form driven in the browser; each reading accepted only when the panel's own selo line equalled 0,8 % of that same reading's price.

calculapt.name: CalculaPT — Simulador de IMT 2026
calculapt.why: Covers what the notaries' simulator does not expose cleanly: the young table, rústicos, outros, and the two Regiões Autónomas separately.
calculapt.method: Form driven in the browser; explicit 'Calcular IMT' button, so each reading corresponds to a committed input.

notes: TOLERANCES DIFFER BY SOURCE, and the reason is a finding rather than a fudge. The notaries agree with this engine to the cent on every point captured. CalculaPT agrees exactly on the young table, rústicos, outros, the taxas únicas and the Regiões Autónomas young/secondary tables, but is off by at most 0,09 € on the tables that carry a parcela a abater — it uses 10 458,04 where the ofício and this engine use 10 457,96, and rounds the selo where this engine ceilings it.

WHICH IS RIGHT IS NOT A MATTER OF OPINION. CIMT art. 17.º n.º 3 constructs the tax as 'a primeira parte à taxa média, o excedente à taxa marginal', which forces the tax to be CONTINUOUS at every bracket boundary. Only this engine's parcelas satisfy that: worst discontinuity across all six tables is 7e-12 €, whereas CalculaPT's value introduces a 0,08 € step at 198 347 €. So the tolerance below accommodates a known defect in that source, and is not licence for this engine to drift.

The notaries' simulator lags one update behind its own inputs — its price line and its tax lines refresh on different cycles. Readings were therefore accepted only when internally consistent (see method). One captured value at 106 346 € was rejected by that check and is absent here; CalculaPT supplies that point instead.

Açores and Madeira return identical figures from CalculaPT at every point tested, which corroborates this engine collapsing both into one 'regioes-autonomas' territory rather than carrying two identical tables.

COVERAGE THIS DOES NOT GIVE: neither simulator returns the verba 17.1 selo on the credit or the verba 17.3.1 selo on interest, so those parts of STAMP_DUTY_2024 remain without an Axis B and that dataset stays unverified.
